headline: Stocks sank for a sixth straight day (S&P 500 -2%, Dow -1,100 points) with the 10-year near 5.04% and the Fed minutes pointing to a likely December hike.
rates: The 10-year Treasury yield eased to about 5.04% from 5.07% on weaker jobless-claims and mid-Atlantic manufacturing data, but it remains near multi-year highs.
fed: The Fed minutes flagged a high likelihood of a 25 basis point hike in December, and Governors Waller (8:25 AM ET) and Cook (12:15 PM ET) speak today after Barr said policy needs further adjustment.
oil: WTI is near $85 and Brent near $92.6 as a Q4 supply surplus (IEA) and a 5.3M-barrel US crude build are offset by Middle East risk premium.
geo: US-Iran fighting and disrupted Strait of Hormuz shipping continue, US-China trade talks ended with no progress on chips or tariffs, and midterm results raised AI-regulation worries.

events.name: Early close after Thanksgiving (markets closed Nov 26)
